title: Easy Spring Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew perfect for a chilly spring evening, made with tender Canadian beef and fresh basil.
instructions: Brown the beef in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the onions and garlic, cooking until the onions are translucent.
Add the flour, stirring to coat the meat and vegetables.
Gradually add the beef broth and red wine, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Stir in the chopped basil during the last 10 minutes of cooking.
Serve hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
